purpose: S81 PQ QB pipelined head (metadata in head), canonical +2 QB pipeline

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_pq_qb_headp_native u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_PQ_ROM_PORTS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/pq/ot_s81_pq_qb_pipe_native.sv physical/s81_pq_hier/pinned/rtl/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81pq_qb_headp_native/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81pq_qb_headp_native/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81pq_qb_headp_native --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_pq_qb_headp_native  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: COMMON CAUSE (10-15, bc0 w1 / headp p1 / align p1 all GRT-0116): wide output buses packed into one dense band of a face (auto pin placement clusters a bus where its flops sit: headp hq at the S-east 30 um, 600 GCells) plus two recipe-2 output hold pads per output pin in that band (align: 33k outhold/bt_d_q/bc_hr_q overflow at the N band). Fix in all three kits: explicit even spreading of every face (tools/ref_tile/spread_face_pins.py, legal M3/M5 alternating N/S, M4 W/E) and no output hold pads (q/hq launch from pin flops; the die receivers carry their own input hold stages). | 10-15 S-ELEM-B: canonical QB +2 pipeline head (physical_request.json): the 6,144 mutable metadata bits (4 banks x 96 rows x 16 b) move from the bank SRAM leaves into the head beside the registered read index (read address capture + SRAM output register = +2 fixed cycles, already in the canonical ABI); bank writes commit one cycle later under the loader contract. Legacy headw slot 73.44x34.56 cannot hold ~7.3k flops: outline = the bank master width 142.56 (rd_data 1024 b on the N face over the four bank N faces), height from the gate's synthesized area. | gate p1 (142.56x86.4: std 6,618 um2, util 58%) REFUSED: one reset relay drove 8,103 loads (meta enables held in reset) and aq_e/aq_p ports fanned out to 391-418 loads. Fix: metadata flops carry no reset; written[] per bank on its own relay region (5 regions); AQ metadata word + write rows/enables re-captured once per bank (4 copies) and the head-local metadata commits one edge after the bank data (bank outputs unchanged; QB pipe bench PASS, 772 packets, +0.24% vs baseline as before). Height 86.4 -> 95.04 for the ~190 added flops (util ~54%). | gate p2 (util 57%, WARN): i0/i1[2:1] drove ~3,600 read-mux loads (reg->reg +75, reg->out +88 pre-route): per-bank 7-bit read-row register copies on the same edge (0 cycles), i0/i1 pins keep their own flops.
